Name: Person Name ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the name record. Only available when updating existing names.

Name: Name Type
Description: The type of name. For the global name supply GLOBAL, for the local name supply the legislation code.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person this name is for.

Name: Person ID

Name: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: Character Set Context
Description: The language of the name. This does not need to be supplied for global names. If you are creating a local name you must supply the language code.

Name: Reference Context
